summary: Comprehensive backend regression run for RAX AI MVP. Wrote pytest suite (22 tests across Auth, Chat, Images, Voice, Content, Admin, Quota) and executed against the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. 22/22 passed (100%). All required endpoints work: idempotent admin seeding, register/login/guest/me JWT, Claude Sonnet 4.5 chat with conversation/message persistence, conversation listing & deletion, Nano Banana image generation (gemini-2.5-flash-image returning base64), TTS (4 voices) + Whisper STT, content generator for tiktok/youtube/viral_ideas, admin users/stats/plan/block with 403 for non-admins, quota counter increments. No MongoDB _id leaks observed in any response.

minor.issue: Email is silently lowercased server-side. Documented in tests; consider returning the canonical email or documenting in API spec so clients aren't surprised.
Creates a brand-new guest user document on every call (no cleanup/TTL). Could grow unbounded over time — consider TTL index on guest users or reusing existing guest token.

action_items: Optional: add TTL/cleanup strategy for guest users (currently unbounded).
Optional: document email lowercasing behaviour in /api/auth/register response/spec.
Backend feature set as specified is fully functional — proceed to frontend testing in next iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~764 lines — close to the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers (auth, chat, images, voice, content, admin) for maintainability.
/api/files/analyze writes user-supplied base64 to /tmp without size limit — add max size guard and explicit cleanup of the tempfile after use.
check_quota only counts via in-doc counters (messages_used/images_used) — no per-day reset window; clarify if 30 messages is lifetime cap or rolling.
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is also forced into os.environ['OPENAI_API_KEY']; harmless but consider passing key explicitly only.
All endpoints already exclude _id via projection ({"_id": 0}) — good practice maintained.
seed_data_creation: Admin user admin@raxai.com seeded via POST /api/admin/seed-admin (idempotent). Several TEST_user_*@example.com accounts created during the run; left in DB (free plan, low footprint). One guest user created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. Use /app/backend/tests/test_raxai_backend.py for regression. Public URL is https://ai-chat-demo-26.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. For frontend testing, this is an Expo/React Native web preview at port 3000; use mobile viewport 375x667 and look for testID attributes on interactive elements. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY based LLM calls are slow (chat ~3-6s, image ~10-30s) so use generous timeouts (>=90s).
rca_of_issue: Single test failure during first run was a test-side bug (asserted exact-case email while backend correctly lowercases). Fixed assertion to compare against email.lower(); rerun green.
